settings.text: Pre-order: this gift set will be delivered on 1 December.

A little taste of the Scottish Highlands: Dunrobin Gin from Golspie, paired with nine handcrafted gin chocolates made locally by Highland Whisky Chocolates.

In the box

  • 1 × 20cl Dunrobin Gin with luxury gift tube
  • 1 × box of 9 handcrafted Highland Whisky Chocolates

settings.heading: Chocolate flavours & allergens
settings.content:
Dark Gin & Mango, Milk Gin & Apple, Milk Gin & Lemon, White Chocolate Mojito Gin, White Gin & Jellybean, Dark Gin & Raspberry.

Ingredients: alcohol, couverture MILK chocolate (minimum 33% cocoa mass), dark chocolate (minimum 56% cocoa), cocoa mass, emulsifier (SOYA lecithin (E322)), vanilla, sugar, whole MILK powder, cocoa butter (32%), invert sugar.

Allergens: contains MILK and SOYA. Made in an environment where nuts may be in use.

settings.heading: Botanicals
settings.content: Juniper, Lemon, coriander, Clove, Blackcurrant, Angelica Root, Rose Scented Pelargonium Leaf

settings.heading: Tasting notes
settings.content:
Flavours: earthy, spiced, piney

Taste: a smooth sip, with a spiced-floral richness, lifted by notes of juniper and forest

Finish: earthy and spicy, with an edge of bitterness

settings.heading: How should I serve the gin?
settings.content: Sip it over ice to open up the flavours. For a classic gin and tonic, use lots of ice, then squeeze a slice of lemon over the glass and drop it in.

settings.heading: How is it delivered?
settings.content: Delivery is by tracked UK Royal Mail 48-hour service, and an adult must sign for the parcel on arrival. We do not deliver outside the UK at the moment. We will update this page and our social media as delivery options develop.
